svg.text: Solid lines show exploratory wells. Dashed lines show development wells. Each well counts
in its first spud year. The numerator counts wells with an initial completion approval by
the file date. Recent cohorts have shorter follow up. A blank means no wells of this type
were first drilled in that band and year. Hollow markers show partial 2026 through 23
